-- 강아지 필터 정보 SELECT dm.dog_match_id, dm.dog_id, dm.breed_gbn_cd, dm.is_mix, dm.weight, dm.weight_category, dm.dog_type_code_gbn_cd, dm.walk_start_time, dm.walk_end_time, dm.walk_days, dm.blood_test_certified, dm.vaccination_certified, dm.health_record_certified, dm.match_type,
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g1.gubn_name) AS dog_personal, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g2.gubn_name) AS dog_play,
CONCAT( IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5, '') ) AS dog_personal_gbn_cd,
CONCAT( IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_1, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_2, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_3, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_4, ''), ',', IFNULL(dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_5, '') ) AS dog_play_gbn_cd,
g3.gubn_name AS breed,
g4.gubn_name AS dog_type
FROM tbl_dog_match dm LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g1 ON g1.group_code = 'dog_personal_code' AND (g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4 OR g1.gubn_code = dm.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5) LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g2 ON g2.group_code = 'dog_play_code' AND (g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_1 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_2 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_3 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_4 OR g2.gubn_code = dm.dog_play_gbn_cd_5) -- breed_code에 해당하는 gubn_name을 가져오는 조인 LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g3 ON g3.group_code = 'breed_code' AND g3.gubn_code = dm.breed_gbn_cd LEFT JOIN tbl_gubn g4 ON g4.group_code = 'dog_type_code' AND g4.gubn_code = dm.dog_type_code_gbn_cd WHERE dm.dog_id = #{dogId} AND dm.match_type = #{matchType} GROUP BY dm.dog_id;

-- 매칭 필터 가져오기 SELECT m.dog_id, m.is_mix, m.breed_gbn_cd, m.weight, m.weight_category, m.walk_days, m.dog_type_code_gbn_cd, m.blood_test_certified, m.vaccination_certified, m.health_record_certified, CONCAT_WS(',', m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_1, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_2, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_3, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_4, m.dog_personal_gbn_cd_5) AS dogPersonalGbnCds, CONCAT_WS(',', m.dog_play_gbn_cd_1, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_2, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_3, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_4, m.dog_play_gbn_cd_5) AS dogPlayGbnCds, m.walk_start_time, m.walk_end_time FROM tbl_dog_match m INNER JOIN tbl_dogs d ON m.dog_id = d.dog_id WHERE m.dog_id = #{dogId} AND d.username = #{username} AND m.match_type = #{matchType}

-- 강아지 매칭 리스트 SELECT DISTINCT d.dog_id, d.username, d.dog_name, d.breed, g.gubn_name AS breedName, d.is_mix, d.gender, d.is_neutered, d.weight, d.personality_type, d.dog_intro, d.personality_type, d.walk_start_time, d.walk_end_time, d.walk_days, d.profile_url, d.blood_test_certified, d.vaccination_certified, d.health_record_certified, (SELECT u.address FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.username = d.username LIMIT 1) AS address, LEFT((SELECT u.address FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.username = d.username LIMIT 1), 2) AS dog_region, LEFT((SELECT u.address FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1), 2) AS user_region FROM tbl_dogs d JOIN tbl_gubn g ON g.group_code = 'breed_code' AND g.gubn_code = d.breed CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT breed_gbn_cd, is_mix FROM tbl_dog_match WHERE dog_id = 1 LIMIT 1) m WHERE d.username <> #{username} -- 품종 필터: 후보 강아지의 품종과 현재 강아지의 필터 값이 일치하거나, 필터가 설정되지 않은 경우 AND (d.breed = m.breed_gbn_cd OR m.breed_gbn_cd IS NULL) -- 믹스 여부 필터: 현재 강아지의 필터가 'N'이면 후보도 'N', 아니면 'Y'인 경우 모두 허용 AND ( (m.is_mix = 'N' AND d.is_mix = 'N') OR m.is_mix = 'Y' ) AND ( #{matchType} <> 'P' OR ( d.is_mating_available = 'Y' AND (#{bloodTestCertified} <> 'Y' OR d.blood_test_certified = 'Y') AND (#{vaccinationCertified} <> 'Y' OR d.vaccination_certified = 'Y') AND (#{healthRecordCertified} <> 'Y' OR d.health_record_certified = 'Y') ) ) -- 지역 필터: 후보 강아지의 주소 앞 2글자와 현재 사용자의 주소 앞 2글자가 동일한 경우 우선 처리 ORDER BY -- 같은 지역이면 1, 아니면 0을 부여하여 내림차순 정렬하면, 같은 지역이 우선으로 오고 그 다음에 다른 지역들이 무작위로 정렬 (CASE WHEN LEFT((SELECT u.address FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.username = d.username LIMIT 1), 2) = LEFT((SELECT u.address FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1), 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, RAND()

UPPER(TRIM(#{code}))
